title: PMF-CL: Pareto-Minimal-Forgetting Continual Learner for Conflicting Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2605.19145v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In the literature, many continual learning (CL) algorithms have been proposed to address the issue of catastrophic forgetting in ML models (i.e., learning new tasks leads to the loss of performance on previously learned tasks). Although all CL approaches use some form of memory to retain information about past tasks, a grounded understanding of what information needs to be stored to minimize catastrophic forgetting remains elusive. Recently, it has been recognized that under the strong assumption of the existence of a common global minimizer over all tasks, catastrophic forgetting can be completely avoided. However, in practice, tasks rarely have a common global minimizer, and a certain amount of forgetting is inevitable. In this paper, we propose a foundational reframing of CL as balancing conflicting tasks in hindsight from a multi-task learning (MTL) perspective. translated_title: PMF-CL：面向冲突任务的帕累托最小遗忘持续学习器
translated_abstract: 在现有文献中，研究者们提出了许多持续学习（CL）算法来解决机器学习模型中的灾难性遗忘问题（即学习新任务会导致模型在已学习任务上的性能下降）。尽管所有持续学习方法都使用某种形式的记忆来保留过去任务的信息，但对于究竟需要存储什么信息才能最小化灾难性遗忘，学界仍然缺乏扎实的理解。最近，人们认识到在所有任务存在共同全局最优解这一强假设下，灾难性遗忘可以被完全避免。然而在实践中，各任务很少拥有共同的全局最优解，因此一定程度的遗忘是不可避免的。在本文中，我们从多任务学习（MTL）的视角对持续学习进行了一种基础性的重新框架，将其视为事后平衡相互冲突的任务。该方法基于寻找帕累托最优解，即……
tldr: 该论文提出PMF-CL，从多任务学习视角将持续学习重新框架为事后平衡冲突任务的问题，通过寻找帕累托最优解来实现在任务无共同最优解的现实情况下最小化遗忘。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes PMF-CL, which fundamentally reframes continual learning as balancing conflicting tasks in hindsight from a multi-task learning perspective, achieving minimal forgetting by finding Pareto-optimal solutions when tasks lack a common global minimizer.
